records.title: MoEGen: Mixture-of-Experts for Instance-Adaptive LoRA Generation
records.reason: The abstract is instance-adaptive LoRA generation/parameter-efficient adaptation; its goal is model adaptation, not inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: Certified Split Points for Parallel Lexing: Exact and Modulo Discarded Tokens
records.reason: The paper certifies split points for parallel lexing; it has no LLM inference or serving contribution.

records.title: Agentic Commerce World: An Auditable and Verifiable Environment for Vibe Commerce
records.reason: ACWorld defines buyer/merchant tasks over static catalogs and deterministic counterparties, with 10 integrity cases and trace reconstruction. It is a research benchmark for commerce-agent behavior; authors state it is not a production payment/security system and that its catalogs do not model live markets. No LLM inference/serving scheduling or efficiency method links it to the serving-disaggregation lineage.

records.title: Stabilizing Extrapolation in Looped Transformers via Learned Stochastic Stopping
records.reason: The learned RL-Halting policy is trained by sampling loop depth and supervising the selected depth. Experiments are synthetic algorithmic length-generalization tasks; the main benefit is lower OOD variance and stability across inference-time loop counts, not demonstrated reductions to LLM serving cost or latency. Authors explicitly frame stopping as a training-time design choice and note learned schedules can stabilize a suboptimal computation.

records.title: Can tourists trust generative AI? A systematic evaluation of the quality of AI-generated tourism information
records.reason: The primary abstract evaluates tourism response quality and prompting across GenAI platforms; it proposes no inference/serving optimization.
